items.source: Customize the handling of HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException.
items.translation: 自定义对HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException的处理。

items.source: Handle the case where no message converters were found for PUT or POSTed content.
items.translation: 处理未找到用于 PUT 或 POST 内容的任何 消息转换器 的情况。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package.
items.translation: 基于 org.springframework.web.method.annotation 包构建的用于注解式处理器方法处理的 MVC 基础设施。

items.source:
Create the method argument value of the expected parameter type by reading
from the given HttpInputMessage.
items.translation: 通过读取给定的 HttpInputMessage 创建预期参数类型的该方法参数值。

items.source:
Create the method argument value of the expected parameter type by
reading from the given request.
items.translation: 通过读取给定的请求来创建预期参数类型的该方法参数值。
